title: AMOS authority document contracts
description: Structure only. Signatures, cross-field ordering and maximum lifetime, amount <= ceiling, current issuer/credential/source/review state, tenant binding, independence and effect validity require runtime verification. Schema validity is never authority.

effect_types.description: Optional. When present, this reviewer’s claim reviews support only these effects (and the internal recommendation).

issuer_state.description: V1 is retained for lab compatibility; text conditions never resolve. V2 requires signed exact-source review and typed, signed condition resolution. Neither establishes real-world authority by itself.
